entries.feedback: First live run hit the GitHub rate limit; scripts carried on and built a wrong plan from partial data.
entries.change: _common.run_gh_json stops the run on a rate-limit error; apply_actions.py checks the call budget before writing; SKILL.md pre-flight checks gh api rate_limit (about 1,500 calls per run).

entries.feedback: Issues and PRs in archived repos were proposed for closing, but archived repos are read-only.
entries.change: fetch_mine.py searches with --archived=false. (The fixture covers the planner; the filter itself is in the gh query.)

entries.feedback: Notifications marked done came back as read with all=true, so every run would re-propose them.
entries.change: fetch_notifications.py lists unread threads only; a done thread with new activity is unread again and returns by itself.

entries.feedback: Unsubscribe was reported as failed: GitHub keeps the subscription with ignored=true instead of deleting it, and the follow-up mark-done was skipped.
entries.change: build_actions.py checks unsubscribe with type 'muted'; apply_actions.py accepts ignored=true or no subscription.

entries.feedback: Self-service Model Inference Run notifications are noise.
Check branches for unmerged work before proposing deletion.
entries.change: fetch_branches.py records branch and PR head SHAs; plan_cleanup.py flags (never proposes) a branch whose head is in none of its PRs.

entries.feedback: Don't silently clear CI failure notices; flag repos with many (ersilia-stats had 17 failed deploys).
entries.change: plan_cleanup.py adds a ci:<repo> flag when a repo has >= notifications.ci_flag_min_threads (5) CI notices; the threads are still proposed as done.
